content.title: Visteon (NASDAQ:VC) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q3 CY2025 Earnings
content.summary: Automotive technology company Visteon (NYSE:VC) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 6.4% year on year to $917 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.78 billion at the midpoint came in 0.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.15 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
